Jordan: quick heads-up — PR #10234 (runtime/kv-cache): small startup warmup tweak. Need two approvers before cutoff at 11:30 PT or CI autobackout will kick in. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/10234 :eyes:
Priya: pinging the usual reviewers. can you confirm smoke results? any risk to existing sessions?
Jordan: ran local smoke + small scale canary. no session drops seen. smoke logs attached below.
Jordan: ```
smoke run --env=canary --seed=42
OK: startup latency median 42ms -> 27ms after tweak
OK: no error-rate increase over 1k requests
```
Sam: I can take a quick look now, aim for a fast approve if tests match.
Maya: what about cold-start tail? did you see any outliers?
Jordan: tail p99 dropped from 520ms -> 310ms in our microbench. still some variance on tiny GPUs but within SLA.
Tina: can you add a one-line note in PR about the metric command you ran? helps reviewers validate.
Jordan: done — added details + link to perf script in PR description.
deploy-bot: CI checks passed — unit, integration, e2e. commit 7f3a2b ok.
Sam: looks fine to me, left a small nit about logging verbosity but not blocking. :+1:
Priya: lgtm from me after nit addressed. can one more person give a quick eye?
Maya: giving my :eyes: and leaving approve — minor logging nit is fine.
Jordan: thanks all — cutting now. will watch canary for 20m and roll forward if green. :rocket:
Priya: noted, i'll stand by for rollback signal.
Sam: thanks — nice win on startup perf.
Jordan: filed a short postmortem note in #eng-runtime after roll if anything odd shows up.
